title: gocloak OAuth2 client, Keychain storage, token refresh
description: Implement gophermind-osx/auth/gocloak.go: OAuth2 Authorization Code flow (in-app login, no browser popup), store access/refresh tokens in macOS Keychain per backend, refresh token 1 min before expiry, logout and credential cleanup. Expose GetToken(backend) for connection manager and service client.
acceptance_criteria: OAuth2 flow: initiates login, receives token, stores in Keychain
Keychain: tokens stored per backend, retrievable, deletable
Token refresh: refreshes 1 min before expiry, transparent to caller
Logout: clears Keychain entry for backend
Unit tests: token storage, refresh, logout, GetToken
